canonical.title: Canonical CHUNKS layers
canonical.description: Displays all layers of materialized chunks. Numbering is local within the selected layer, not global across the document.

retrieval.title: Basis of Risk Analysis (RAG Evidence)
retrieval.description: Working evidence-chunks used for the checks are shown on the left. The context section is displayed separately in the selected chunk's card.

listPanel.noChunks: No chunks in the selected layer.
listPanel.canonicalNote: Important note: <bold>numbering is local within the selected layer</bold>. Technical index is stored in JSON/debug.
listPanel.retrievalNote: Only <bold>evidence-chunks</bold> (working retrieval fragments) are shown on the left. The associated section is shown in the card on the right as context.

canonical.title: Canonical materialized chunk
canonical.description: Displays a single chunk of the selected layer. UID is the chunk's anchor, not a promise of a perfect boundary exactly along one clause.

retrieval.title: RAG evidence chunk
retrieval.description: Displays the working retrieval-visible fragment and the associated context section of this area.

detailPanel.canonicalNoteUid: <bold>UID is the anchor identity of the chunk</bold>, not a guarantee that text will perfectly match exactly one visible clause of the contract. Therefore, a chunk with uid `{{uid}}` may contain text of 2.2, 2.3, and subsequent lines of the same block.
detailPanel.canonicalNoteLeaf: <bold>Leaf-node clause chunk:</bold> this clause layer chunk corresponds to a leaf-node of the clause tree. Internal numbered subclauses might not be separate clause-nodes.
detailPanel.canonicalNoteRaw: Displays raw materialized text. At the chunk boundary, next section headers or adjacent block boundary lines may occur.
detailPanel.canonicalNoteSection: This is the context section layer: such a chunk can contain an entire section of the contract and serves as a broad context layer.
detailPanel.retrievalNote: This is a working <bold>evidence chunk</bold> of the retrieval corpus. Below, the associated <bold>context section</bold> is shown separately so that the user sees not only the fragment but also the broader section of the document.

language_selection_required.label: Language selection required
language_selection_required.tooltip: Document upload complete. For documents with several detected languages, further processing is stopped until the primary analysis language is selected. Russian is set by default.
language_selection_required.description: Document upload complete. For documents with several detected languages, further processing — including translation to monolingual format, extraction, sanitization, structure building, chunking, and classification — will not proceed until the primary analysis language is selected. Russian is set by default.
